stem: Based on the information in the selection, the reader can conclude that a main problem researchers studying déjà vu encounter is that —

options.label: F
options.text: past research studies about déjà vu are unreliable

options.label: G
options.text: most people do not remember when they have experienced déjà vu

options.label: H

options.label: J
